clue.text: Untrustworthy fellow wearing suit falls

clue.text: They pump up fast — union gets agitated

clue.text: Plane totally emptied landing stage

clue.text: "Clink" — Good on Heather for multitasking!

clue.text: Intentionally lose argument, following temperature getting hot

clue.text: Overeat last of the new Cheddar?

clue.text: They make several tips on hoofed animals

clue.text: Rains sounded like some hammers

clue.text: Identity of small fairy

parts.note: S is the abbreviation for small, as on clothing labels
an elf is a small fairy-like being

clue.text: What came before Daley's doors in Ireland once

explanation.definitionFit: Erin is an archaic and poetic name for the island of Ireland, as in 'Erin go bragh'.

clue.text: Grasping talent agency stripped down to essentials, causing bad temper

explanation.definitionFit: Spleen means anger or ill humour, from the old belief that the organ was the seat of irritability.

clue.text: I don't know secretary's son

clue.text: Bit heads off three ancient deities

clue.text: Performances set in our dance

indicators.note: letters that dance hop about into a new order

clue.text: Function of clubs: Love shacks, ultimately!

explanation.walkthrough: 'Love Shack' was a 1989 hit by the B-52s, a staple of club nights.
explanation.definitionFit: Cos is the standard abbreviation for cosine, a trigonometric function.

clue.text: They classically have three styles of newspaper articles

clue.text: Stop developing sailor's independent force before the end of January

clue.text: Secret I stumbled over — piece of plot

clue.text: Stone age blocks meld amorphously

explanation.definitionFit: An emerald is a green gemstone, a precious stone of the beryl family.

clue.text: Morag finally consumed gold cake

clue.text: It could be the result of taking these from inquest

clue.text: The press only partially blame Diana
